0022600219.text: Boston comes into this 12th game of the season at 9-2, first in the Atlantic and first in the East, with a four-game winning streak, a 9-1 record over its last ten, and a 4-2 road mark. Toronto is 5-5, sixth in the East and 3.5 games back in the Atlantic, and is coming off a one-game losing streak, with Paul George (illness) out for the Celtics and Kawhi Leonard (knee, inflammation), Nate Bittle (foot, fracture), Scottie Barnes (groin, soreness), and Trayce Jackson-Davis (illness) out for the Raptors. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and the Celtics won the 2025-26 season series 4-0, including a 115-101 win in Boston on April 5, 2026.
